title: yb-ctl is failing when passing vmodule with several modules inside master_flags

./bin/yb-ctl --rf=1 create --tserver_flags '"vmodule=meta_cache=5,tablet=5"' --master_flags '"vmodule=meta_cache=5,tablet=5",tablet_creation_timeout_ms=2000'
